Finding: `packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45` is the single resolver that applies the organization override (`if (organizationHideBranding) return true`). The booking pages call it (`shouldHideBrandingForEvent` / `…ForTeamEvent` / `…ForUserEvent`). The automation path does not: `packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, 274-276, 433-435` reads `booking.eventType.team.hideBranding ?: booking.user.hideBranding` straight off the rows `getWorkflowReminders.ts:170,201` selected (team's `parentId` but never `parent.hideBranding`), and the booking-side triggers pass `eventType.owner?.hideBranding` only.

{"contract":"Whether the product's own name and logo are stripped from anything a customer's account emits must be decided in exactly one place — the centralized resolver in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts, which picks the team branch for team events and the owner branch otherwise and lets a parent organization's hideBranding override the entity's own setting. Every consumer, whether it renders the public booking page or renders and sends an automated workflow message, must obtain the flag from that resolver (or from a query that carries the same parent/organization join) rather than dereferencing a raw hideBranding column off a user, team or event-type owner row; a consumer that reads the raw column resolves a different answer for the same customer than the booking page does.","defect_location":{"repo":"calcom/cal.com","summary":"The contract is defined at packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 (resolveHideBranding returns true whenever organizationHideBranding is set, otherwise falls back to the entity's own flag) and exposed as getHideBranding (:50-80, joining via UserRepository.findUserWithHideBranding at packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:1323-1339 and TeamRepository.findTeamWithParentHideBranding at packages/features/ee/teams/repositories/TeamRepository.ts:462-474) and shouldHideBrandingForEvent (:116-181). The booking pages honour it: apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299, apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61,103, apps/web/lib/org/[orgSlug]/instant-meeting/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:85, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36 and apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:251-253. The automation path does not. packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, :274-276 and :433-435 compute brandingDisabled as `reminder.booking.eventType?.team ? !!team.hideBranding : !!booking.user?.hideBranding` — a raw read with no organization override — and feeds it to customTemplate (packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/customTemplate.ts:216) and emailReminderTemplate (packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/emailReminderTemplate.ts:82-83), which are the two places that append `Scheduling by ${APP_NAME}` to the outgoing body. The rows it reads come from packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:164-171 and :198-203, whose select takes user.hideBranding and team.parentId + team.hideBranding but never parent.hideBranding, so the org override is not even in the payload. The same raw-read pattern occurs at every booking-side workflow trigger, each of which drops the team branch entirely and uses the event-type owner: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671 (and a hardcoded hideBranding:true at :604), and packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188. Those values then travel untouched through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56,97,213,248,262-280, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18,27,82, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38,115,147,182,204 and packages/features/tasker/tasks/triggerFormSubmittedNoEvent/triggerFormSubmittedNoEventWorkflow.ts:29,41,66 into the template. By contrast packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 do call getHideBranding, but key it on workflow.userId/workflow.teamId and form.userId/form.teamId rather than on the event type the booking belongs to — a second way the automation's answer diverges from the booking page's.
